prompt_transform.guidance: Define stable spatial anchors, entrance/exit direction, background layers, and key props for reusable scene geography.
prompt_transform.template: Scene/Production Design: {scene} has stable spatial anchors and prop hierarchy that can be reused across nodes.

negative_constraints: Do not redesign the location every time a new node is optimized.
Do not add unrelated props that distract from the beat.
quality_checks: Foreground, midground, and background hierarchy is clear.

source_refs.label: Adobe cinematography overview
source_refs.note: Cinematography includes composition, lighting, lens, and movement decisions.

prompt_transform.guidance: Only promote props that reveal character, trigger action, clarify setting, or support continuity.
prompt_transform.template: Scene/Production Design: props support {action}; name only props that matter to the beat.

negative_constraints: Do not fill the frame with generic cinematic clutter.
Do not introduce a prop if it has no story or composition function.
quality_checks: Each named prop has a visual or narrative role.
Props do not compete with the subject.

source_refs.label: Visual Story storyboards and shot lists
source_refs.note: Preparation clarifies shot selection, framing, lighting, and set design.

prompt_transform.guidance: Use a few material and texture cues to make the set tangible without overpowering action.
prompt_transform.template: Scene/Production Design: material texture in {scene} reinforces {style} and remains secondary to the subject.

negative_constraints: Do not list many materials with no hierarchy.
Do not choose textures that contradict the lighting mood.
quality_checks: Texture choices fit the light and location.

source_refs.label: Google Cloud Veo prompting guide
source_refs.note: Context and ambiance make prompts more controllable.

prompt_transform.guidance: For short-video targets, keep subject hierarchy readable in vertical crop and avoid edge-critical details.
prompt_transform.template: Scene/Production Design: compose {subject} and key props for short-video safe framing.

negative_constraints: Do not place essential faces, hands, or text at unsafe crop edges.
Do not rely on tiny background details for story clarity.
quality_checks: Composition hierarchy remains readable on mobile.

source_refs.label: Google Cloud Veo prompting guide
source_refs.note: Prompt structure includes context and style for controllability.
